WAY HUGE® SMALLS™ RED LLAMA Toggle menu Compare --> Register I Sign in Search Bag Search Close Products --> All Products --> --> Electronics MXR Cry Baby Way Huge Dunlop Electronics Authentic Hendrix Pedal Parts Electronic Parts Legacy Products Guitar Picks Tortex Nylon Max-Grip Jazz Herco Gator Grip Celluloid Ultex Primetone Delrin 500 Flow Finger & Thumb Stubby Variety Packs Artist Series Graphic Artist Series Pick Tins Other Clearance Accessories Capos Slides & Tonebars MXR Cables Care & Maintenance Strap Retainer Straps Tuners Pick Holders GrooveTech Tools Accu-Fret Fretwire Clearance Strings Artist Series Electric Bass Acoustic Classical Americana Ukulele Apparel Shirts Hoodies Hats Artists Lifestyle Sign in WAY HUGE® SMALLS™ RED LLAMA WM23 Description Celebrating the 30th anniversary of Way Huge, the beloved RL2 Red Llama Overdrive (Way Huge’s first production pedal, introduced in 1992) returns with a vengeance.   *LEGACY PRODUCT / NO LONGER IN PRODUCTION Warranty Information The Long Story The iconic Red Llama Overdrive is back—and more compact than ever! Beware: this llama can bite. But it also purrs. And screams, if you smack it just right. Celebrating the 30th anniversary of Way Huge, the beloved RL2 Red Llama Overdrive (Way Huge’s first production pedal, introduced in 1992) returns with a vengeance. Sporting a new compact Smalls enclosure, the WM23 conjures all the warm goodness of the original Red Llama Overdrive. It dishes out delicious harmonic overdrive, reminiscent of a crunchy tweed amp, and offers a wide array of tones ranging from soft and cuddly to burly and brutal. Mr. Huge spent months testing modern components to recreate the sound of the 1990s era Red Llama Overdrive, retaining all the touch sensitivity and mojo of the original. Visit his petting zoo with your favorite guitar and plug into the WM23. You might lose a few fingers and toes, but you’ll be glad you did. The WM23 Smalls Red Llama is the compact return of the Red Llama Overdrive. Jim Dunlop identifies the original RL2 as Way Huge's first production pedal, introduced in 1992, and describes the WM23 as a smaller-format return intended to reproduce the harmonic, touch-sensitive character of the earlier Red Llama.

- Way Huge Smalls enclosure with Red Llama graphics.
- Finish/artwork differences remain variations unless the underlying product is materially different.

- First Way Huge production pedal, introduced in **1992**.
- Harmonic overdrive with a crunchy tweed-style character.

- **1,000 pieces worldwide**.
- Smaller pedalboard-friendly housing.
- Added **Hi-Cut** control.

- Compact anniversary-era version.
- Controls: **Volume** and **Drive**.
- Hardwire-relay bypass.
- 9V battery or compatible external supply.

- RL2 established the 1992 original.
- WHE-206 added Hi-Cut and limited-edition 25th-anniversary treatment.
- WM23 brought the Red Llama back in the smaller Smalls enclosure with the two-knob external control layout.

- Exact production transistor/device information is not specified in the manufacturer documentation reviewed.

- Exact production clipping/rectification diode information is not specified in the manufacturer documentation reviewed.

Way Huge describes the Red Llama as a harmonic overdrive capable of moving from soft, touch-sensitive drive into more aggressive, fuzz-like saturation. The WM23 is intended to retain the warm, crunchy tweed-like character of the original in a compact enclosure.

Download this manual POWER The Red Llama™ Overdrive is powered by a single 9-volt battery, a 9-volt AC adapter such as the Dunlop ECB003, or the DC Brick and Iso-Brick power supplies. The power input is a 5.5mm x 2.1mm ™ jack with the positive voltage on the outer sleeve. Using an external power supply will disconnect the battery. Disconnect the input jack to preserve battery life when not in use. The pedal will lock into bypass mode when it is time to change the battery. It also includes power protection circuitr y to prevent damage from AC power supplies.
